verdicts.reason: A keeps the chef-hat, tools, dome and plate emblem together as one centred unit, scaled up to suit the square canvas. Its only flaws are that the 'B' and 'Y' of 'BBQ PARTY' run past the dome's edges onto the busy meat photo (as in the original), and the cleaver blade crowds the dome. B breaks the emblem apart: a huge chef hat sits on its own top-left over the meat, the cleaver and spatula are scattered tiny on the white noodles, red line pieces float loose mid-canvas, and the shrunken headline dome is pushed off to the right. That kills the hierarchy and the original logo-like look.
